notes: Peptide and drug code names (BPC-157, TB-500, GHK-Cu, CJC-1295, LY3437943) stay exactly as written.

Generic drug and peptide names (semaglutide, tirzepatide, retatrutide, kisspeptin) use the standard spelling of the target language, as in its medical literature (for example semaglutida in Spanish, Semaglutid in German, semaglutyd in Polish).
Study names, journal names, author names and citation lines ("Wilding et al. · NEJM 2021") stay as written.
Agency names keep their English abbreviation (FDA, EMA, WADA); spell out the name in the target language only where the English spells it out.
